'''UE Extremenya''' is an Andorran [[association football|football]] club based in the parish of [[La Massana]].<ref>{{cite web |title=UE Extremenya |url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/89672--extremenya/ |website=UEFA.com |access-date=10 April 2025}}</ref> The club currently plays in [[Segona Divisió]].<ref>{{cite web |title=UE Extremenya |url=https://www.sofascore.com/team/football/ue-extremenya/37967 |website=Sofacore |access-date=10 April 2025}}</ref>"}}
